tool.name: Open Tool
tool.description: Create a new tool (provide name + description; server generates slug) or open an existing tool by slug on the current starship. Returns a lean tool summary (no blueprint).

name.description: Human-readable name (required when creating a new tool)

slug.description: Unique kebab-case identifier of the tool to open

description.description: Description (required when creating a new tool; max 320 characters)

nodes.name: Prepare Request
nodes.description: Build URL, headers and body based on mode (create or open)

nodes.name: Route Mode
nodes.description: Route to create vs open based on prepare.mode

nodes.name: Create Tool (Starships)
nodes.description: POST /starships/:starshipId/tools via Starships connector endpoint catalog

nodes.name: Get Tool (Starships)
nodes.description: GET /starships/:starshipId/tools/:slug via Starships connector endpoint catalog

nodes.name: Unwrap
nodes.description: Return body.data/body.error where applicable; otherwise return body/resp

nodes.name: Slim Tool
nodes.description: Return a lean tool summary (omit heavy/unneeded fields like blueprint)

nodes.name: End
nodes.description: Return lean tool summary (created or fetched)
